nodes.label: Landlord notifies the tenant of a rent increase for the next possible termination date
nodes.why: The landlord may increase rent for the next possible termination date and must notify the tenant of the increase.

nodes.label: Determine whether the rent-increase notice uses the canton-approved prescribed form
nodes.why: The landlord must use a canton-approved form, and an increase notified without the prescribed form is void.

nodes.label: Rent increase is void
nodes.why: A rent increase is void where the landlord does not notify it using the prescribed form.

nodes.label: Tenant requests a numerical justification of the claimed difference amount
nodes.why: For increases based on cost increases or value-enhancing improvements, the tenant may request a numerical justification.

nodes.label: Tenant decides whether to challenge the rent increase as abusive before the conciliation authority
nodes.why: The tenant may challenge the increase before the conciliation authority as abusive, while the listed circumstances establish when rents are generally not abusive.

nodes.label: No challenge is brought before the conciliation authority
nodes.why: The propositions provide a tenant right and a deadline to challenge but do not state the legal result of not bringing a challenge.

nodes.label: Tenant submits a conciliation request challenging the rent increase
nodes.why: A rent-increase challenge is made before the conciliation authority, and the procedure is initiated by a conciliation request that may be submitted in the specified forms or orally for the record.

nodes.label: Conciliation authority conducts informal negotiations and seeks an agreement covering the tenancy
nodes.why: The conciliation authority must attempt informal reconciliation and seek an agreement covering the entire tenancy, with a hearing held within the stated period.

nodes.label: Tenant requests production of relevant supporting documents for the asserted increase grounds
nodes.why: In conciliation proceedings, the tenant may request relevant supporting documents for all asserted grounds for the rent increase.

nodes.label: Determine whether an agreement, acknowledgment of claim, or unconditional withdrawal of claim is reached
nodes.why: The propositions distinguish the procedural consequences where an agreement is reached from those where no agreement is reached.

nodes.label: Conciliation authority records the agreed matter, obtains signatures, and provides the minutes to each party
nodes.why: Upon agreement, acknowledgment, or unconditional withdrawal, the authority must record the matter, have it signed, and provide each party a copy.

nodes.label: Conciliation authority records lack of agreement and issues authorization to sue to the landlord
nodes.why: If no agreement is reached in a challenged rent-increase matter, the authority must record that fact and issue authorization to sue to the landlord or lessor.

nodes.label: Landlord may file an action with the court under the authorization to sue
nodes.why: The authorization entitles its holder to file an action after opening, subject to the specified action period for residential and commercial tenancy disputes.

transitions.condition: The notice does not use the prescribed canton-approved form
The notice uses the prescribed canton-approved form
The increase is due to cost increases or value-enhancing improvements and the tenant requests numerical justification
Tenant challenges the increase as abusive within 30 days after communication
Tenant does not bring a challenge within 30 days after communication
Tenant requests relevant supporting documents in the conciliation proceedings
An agreement, acknowledgment of claim, or unconditional withdrawal of claim is reached
Landlord files an action within the applicable 30-day period after opening

deadlines.period: At least ten days before the beginning of the notice period
deadlines.runs_from: Before the beginning of the notice period
After the rent increase has been communicated to the tenant
Receipt of the application or completion of the exchange of written submissions

obligations.statement: Notify the tenant of the rent increase on a form approved by the canton and state the reasons for it.
Provide the notification and reasons at least ten days before the beginning of the notice period.

The rent-increase form must state the previous rent and ancillary-cost charge, the new rent and ancillary-cost charge, the effective date, and the reason for the increase, and must contain the statutory contestation requirements and the list of conciliation authorities and their local jurisdiction.
Attempt to reconcile the parties in informal negotiations and seek an agreement covering the entire tenancy.
Record the settlement, acknowledgment of claim, or unconditional withdrawal in the minutes and have the parties sign it.
Record the lack of agreement in the minutes and issue authorization to sue to the landlord in a challenged rent-increase matter.

unsupported_gaps.what_is_missing: The legal consequence of a rent-increase notice that uses the prescribed form but omits or incorrectly states a required form content, reason, or timing requirement.
unsupported_gaps.why_it_matters: The propositions expressly make an increase void only when the prescribed form is not used; they do not state whether other notification or form-content defects also make the increase void.

unsupported_gaps.what_is_missing: The legal consequence of failing to challenge a non-void rent increase within 30 days.
unsupported_gaps.why_it_matters: The propositions impose a 30-day challenge period but do not state whether expiry validates the increase, bars the challenge, or has another consequence.

unsupported_gaps.what_is_missing: A merits determination by the conciliation authority or court on whether the challenged increase is abusive.
unsupported_gaps.why_it_matters: The propositions provide criteria for rents generally not being abusive and prescribe conciliation steps, but do not state a decision rule or outcome for the authority or court on the challenge.

scope: a tenant challenging a rent increase imposed by the landlord, including whether the increase is void for defect of form
